purpose: Give the outcome after a long or difficult process.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
After many discussions, we decided to move.
After lengthy negotiations, we reached an agreement.
After much deliberation, I decided not to apply this time.
restrictions: The outcome may be positive or negative; emphasizes the preceding process.
mistake: Use あげく for an explicitly regrettable result.
